main.description: Register a globally surplus / dead-stock / overstock / unsold-inventory lot for donation-based redistribution within the religious-corp economy. Per ADR-2605211241. Donor must be SBT Adherent or attested non-Adherent commercial donor (donation-only, non-profit). Wellbecoming constraint: routing priority redistributed -> recycled (via toshiKozan) -> disposed-licensed; dispose-first is prohibited at the state-enum level (see flagDeadStock). 10% tithe coupling: emit com.etzhayyim.apps.payment.sent {purpose:donation, amountUsdcMicros: estimatedValueUsdcMicros} in the same batch and the TitheRouter splits 10% to the Public Fund per ADR-2605192130.

lotId.description: Donor-side stable identifier for the lot. Recommended: urn:uuid:...

category.description: High-level product category. Drives downstream toshiKozan streamType mapping when state becomes flagged-dead-stock.

skuCode.description: Optional SKU code for catalog reference. May match an existing com.etzhayyim.apps.warehouse.registerSku record.

warehouseSkuRef.description: Optional AT URI of an existing com.etzhayyim.apps.warehouse.registerSku record this lot pertains to. Avoids duplicating the SKU master.

description.description: Plain-language description. PII-free. No promotional / ad-style language (Charter Rider §2).

unitOfMeasure.description: Units of quantity. e.g., piece, kg, liter, m, pallet, container-20ft.

weightKgTotal.description: Total lot weight in kilograms. Used for cross-border / freight estimation.

estimatedValueUsdcMicros.description: Donor self-attested value of the lot in USDC base units (6 decimals). Drives the 10% in-kind tithe coupling. Inflation by donors is mitigated by valuationAttestationUri (third-party attestation, optional).

valuationAttestationUri.description: Optional AT URI of a third-party valuation attestation record. Recommended for lots above 10000 USDC.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor. Must be either an Adherent SBT holder or an attested non-Adherent commercial donor (donation-only per ADR-2605192115).

donorKind.description: Default: adherent-sbt. Non-Adherent donors require prior attestation by Council Lv6+ multisig.

originWarehouseDid.description: Optional DID of the warehouse/facility where the lot is physically located.

shelfLifeRemainingDays.description: Days until best-before / expiry. 0 or negative means already past nominal shelf life (still potentially donatable for non-food categories).

hazardFlags.description: Multi-select hazard flags. Drives routing constraints (e.g., li-ion-battery forces flagDeadStock direct path to toshiKozan if redistribution not safe).

dppBadgeRef.description: Optional AT URI of an ESPR Digital Product Passport (com.etzhayyim.apps.textileCircularity.registerDppBadge) when applicable.

did.description: DID assigned to this surplus lot.
